newsitem.title: USA: Metris Cos Q4 net soars on credit growth.
newsitem.headline: Metris Cos Q4 net soars on credit growth.

text.p: Metris Cos Inc said Thursday added credit card fees and income helped earnings in the fourth quarter reach $5.3 million, compared to $0.4 million one year ago.

The company said managed credit card fees, interchange and other credit card income climbed 205 percent in the period to $32.7 million, Metris said, primarily because of growth in total accounts and receivables in the credit card loan portfolio.
Metris is a direct marketer of consumer credit products.
Its shares closed up on-1/4 Thursday at 29-3/8.
